parts.name: heart_disease_logit
parts.original_hypothesis: Additive composition at the logit: a 15-term linear model plus four hidden corrections, then sigmoid. Unlike a plain logistic regression, thal has no direct edge: it acts only through thal_defect_oldpeak (abnormal thal: +3 logit and steep oldpeak slope) and the age hinge. no_angina_bp_gate subtracts risk without exercise angina and makes BP matter only with it. older_normal_fbs_age_hinge flattens/reverses the age effect for older normal-sugar patients with abnormal thal. ca_relay is an affine boost to the ca weight. Hidden units carry substantial signal: mean-ablating all of them drops train AUC from 0.960 to 0.870. cp:2, restecg:0, restecg:2 and thal:7 are unconnected, zero-effect entries. Evidence (train, n=242): Root logit = -0.586 + direct linear terms (SD 2.84) + 1.658*ca_relay (SD 0.48) - 0.678*no_angina_bp_gate (SD 1.21) + 1.749*thal_defect_oldpeak (SD 2.38) - 1.469*older_normal_fbs_age_hinge (SD 1.09); total logit SD 4.61. Train AUC 0.9605, acc 0.897. Mean-ablating all four readout hidden nodes: AUC 0.870. Largest direct weights (per SD): ca 1.33, slope:2 1.08, trestbps 0.84, sex:1 0.71, fbs:1 -0.68, chol 0.62, cp:3 -0.59, age 0.56. Inputs cp:2, restecg:0, restecg:2, thal:7 have no edges (zero effect); thal enters only via hidden units.

parts.original_hypothesis: Thal-defect x oldpeak gate. For patients with an abnormal thallium scan (fixed or reversible defect) and chest pain other than typical angina, it is always on and affine: +2.37 logit offset plus +2.51 logit per oldpeak SD. For normal thal, it is off unless oldpeak exceeds +0.81 SD (11/123 train rows). Typical angina (cp:1) shifts it down by 1.76 logit. It carries the network's main thal effect (mean +3.0 logit abnormal vs +0.16 normal) and makes oldpeak matter far more with a thal defect.
